jobs.title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte
jobs.description: Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau (Reinickendorf) suchen wir dich als Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte (m/w/d). Auch Quereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen! Wir sind Akademis Internatsberatung, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsagentur. Wir helfen Familien, ein passendes Internat im Ausland zu finden, und begleiten sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Rückkehr ihres Kindes. Dabei teilen wir ihre Vorfreude, nehmen ihre Sorgen ernst und kümmern uns um die vielen kleinen und großen Fragen unterwegs. Eine Aufgabe, die dir am Herzen liegt Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, dem gute Arbeit persönlich wichtig ist: Du möchtest Eltern und Jugendliche aufmerksam begleiten, hältst Zusagen ein und bleibst an offenen Anliegen dran. Auch bei den Details arbeitest du gewissenhaft – denn auf deine Auskünfte, Unterlagen und Absprachen sollen sich andere verlassen können. Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der die persönliche Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team schätzt und selbst zu einer guten Atmosphäre beiträgt: mit Freundlichkeit, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einem ehrlichen, respektvollen Umgang. Dafür stehen dir eine gründliche Einarbeitung und ein hilfsbereites Team zur Seite. Aufgaben Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen. jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to. You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship.

Dein Ziel ist es, unser Healthcare-Geschäft auszubauen, neue Partnerschaften insbesondere im GKV- und PKV-Umfeld zu gewinnen und bestehende Partner nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung und Entwicklung strategischer Partnerschaften und im Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen. Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im GKV-/PKV-Umfeld ist ein starkes Plus; alternativ hast du Erfahrung darin, relevante Netzwerke erfolgreich

jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description: About us Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results. Project description (TUM Project) This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact. The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice. Objectives of the project study to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand), to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective, to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results, to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect. Main task and methodology Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling. Student requirements Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. tags: ltds - laboratoire de tribologie et dynamique des systèmes
jobs.description: Contexte Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau

jobs.title: Trainee Marketing, Analytics & AI
jobs.description: Ready to go from graduate to trusted advisor for Europe’s best-known brands in just 12 months? Expect a steep learning curve, real responsibility, and hands-on experience working with AI every day. 💚 About us Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Most companies still judge their marketing by last-click. Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy. 🚀 Your mission Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. After one year, you look after your own clients and move into a permanent role in our Customer Success & Account Management team. 🗺️ Your year at Nexoya Foundations (Months 1 to 3): You learn how digital advertising works, from search to social to display, using Google, Meta, TikTok and Snapchat as examples. Then you dive into analytics and attribution, understand how our algorithms optimize budgets, and get your personal AI toolkit. Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - UK
jobs.description: Hi I’m Colin , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby . To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby. When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way). To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path. We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe. In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yo

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. En collaboration directe avec les managers des différentes équipes, tu seras chargé.e de comprendre leurs besoins et de les aider à recruter les personnes les plus adaptées. Il s'agit d'un poste central chez Doctrine, et tu contribueras directement à notre croissance. Tu feras partie de l'équipe People et sera rattaché.e à notre DRH, Gabrielle de Luppé, et en plus des hiring managers, tu travailleras au quotidien avec quatre autres TAM qui connaissent parfaitement Doctrine. Unsere akademischen und beruflichen Hintergründe liegen in Informatik, Design & Computation und Human Computer Interaction. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine neue Plattform für die Organisation und Zusammenarbeit in der digitalen Musikproduktion. Unser Produkt soll es ermöglichen, verschiedene Projektstände und ihre Entstehung nachzuvollziehen, frühere Versionen wiederherzustellen und Projekte zwischen unterschiedlichen Produktionsumgebungen auszutauschen. Damit möchten wir mehr Raum für musikalisches Experimentieren schaffen, den organisatorischen Aufwand in kreativen Arbeitsprozessen reduzieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Musikschaffenden erleichtern. Mögliche Schwerpunkte sind: Communications & PR: Entwicklung unserer Außenkommunikation, Vermittlung unserer Produktidee und Aufbau von Sichtbarkeit innerhalb der Musikbranche und darüber hinaus. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. jobs.description: Über uns Die Weiler Consult GmbH ist eine Power-BI-Boutique für den deutschen Mittelstand und das Konzernumfeld. Rund 10 Power-BI-Expertinnen und -Experten bauen Reporting, das Geschäftsführer und CFOs wirklich nutzen. Unser Prinzip: Wir sind der Sherpa. Wir arbeiten remote-first, deutschlandweit, und treffen uns dreimal im Jahr zur Workation. Worum es geht Du bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, vom Kickoff bis zur Verlängerung. Du machst sichtbar, was unsere Power-BI-Arbeit in den Zahlen des Kunden verändert, und steuerst die Umsetzung mit Entwicklern und Freelancern. In deiner Verantwortung liegen rund 10 bis 12 Kunden. Deine Aufgaben Du führst die Kundenbeziehungen, kennst Ziele und Kennzahlen deiner Kunden und hältst ihr Feedback in ClickUp fest. Du benennst die Veränderung in den Zahlen des Kunden, nicht die gelieferten Dashboards. Mit jedem Kunden führst du pro Quartal ein Strategie- und Roadmap-Gespräch: Zufriedenheit, Erfolge, Zielbild für zwei Jahre, Roadmap. Verlängerungen gehst du aktiv und rechtzeitig vor Vertragsende an. Aus der Roadmap entwickelst du Folgeprojekte. In der Umsetzung schneidest und priorisierst du Aufgaben in ClickUp, hältst Termine und koordinierst Entwickler und Freelancer. Du führst die Power-BI-Entwickler fachlich. Bei Unzufriedenheit, Budgetrisiko oder drohender Abwanderung eskalierst du früh. Das bringst du mit Du führst Kundengespräche selbstständig. Du verstehst betriebswirtschaftliche Zahlen und sprichst mit einem CFO auf Augenhöhe. Du kannst Power-BI-Berichte lesen und erklären. Du hältst Termine zuverlässig. jobs.title: Retention Lead / CRM (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Turnover besetzt aktuell eine Lead/Head of Retention Position für eine etablierte D2C Brand. Das Unternehmen erzielt über 100 Mio. € Jahresumsatz und sucht eine Person, die Retention als eigenständigen Wachstumstreiber verantwortet, das CRM Team führt und gemeinsam mit einem crossfunktionalen Team den Customer Lifetime Value weiterentwickelt. 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Aufgaben Du verantwortest die CRM und Retention Strategie entlang des gesamten Customer Lifecycles, vom Onboarding bis zur Reaktivierung. Du steuerst zentrale Business KPIs wie Customer Lifetime Value, Wiederkaufrate, Retention, Churn und Bestandskundenumsatz. Qualifikation Mehrjährige Erfahrung in CRM, Retention oder Lifecycle Marketing, idealerweise in einem D2C, Subscription oder Consumer Umfeld. Fundierte E-Commerce-Erfahrung und ein tiefes Verständnis für die relevanten Geschäftsmodelle, Customer Journeys und Wachstumshebel – E-Commerce-Erfahrung ist für diese Position ein Must-have. Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams. Ein tiefes Verständnis von CLV, Retention, Churn, Wiederkaufraten, Kohorten und LTV. Strategisches Denken, echte Hands on Mentalität und den Wunsch, Verantwortung nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern Dinge sichtbar voranzubringen. jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.description: GTM Associate London, 4x days per week in-office Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth. About Vega Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side. Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right. Who we are We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do. How we do it Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you: We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress.

jobs.title: Senior Chief Platform Architect - 801
jobs.description: We are seeking an Chief Platform Architect in our CO, MN, or UK locations. As the Chief Platform Architect for the Quantum Software Developer Platform, you will act as the technical authority for the design Quantinuum’s developer platform: access portals for quantum computers, hybrid work-flow orchestration, tooling access, documentation, and security. You will work with other leaders on hardware-software co-design efforts, ensuring our platform is scalable and enabling of our quantum processors. You will mentor senior engineers, ensure excellent coding standards, and help define and execute on the technical roadmap to translate business needs into robust, production-ready systems. Key Responsibilities: Own the design and specifications of a high-performance developer platform. Refine quantum computer access API and web portal architecture for performance, scalability and multi-region operation Transform web portal into an application development and delivery framework by leveraging cloud-based hybrid workflow engine and reusable quantum/classical application components Define standard interfaces for hosting application components and building applications by both internal and external developers Ensure the security and reliability of the platform as it scales up Deliver customizable cloud-based hybrid applications to end users Work across the business to help define and maintain the technology roadmap, translating business goals into technical requirements and evaluating new technologies. Foster a culture of excellence by establishing best coding practices, performing architectural reviews, and mentoring senior software engineers. YOU MUST HAVE: 25+ years in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior architect or lead role, specifically within developer platforms. WE VALUE: Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native solutions. Expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, developer portals (e.g., Backstage), and observability tools.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleid

jobs.title: Merchant Growth Specialist
jobs.description: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers. As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real.
